note: How the Domains page groups the packs for the person choosing. covered_org_types marks an organization type that has its own pack: it stays in the list in grey and links there. A group is only a way to choose; each pack keeps its slug, controls and assessments. Every pack is in exactly one group. Group accents mark identity only (card band and icon): they keep 4.5:1 contrast on white and stay at least 40 degrees apart in hue, except the neutral slate of the last group (see tests).
